scope: Read-only correctness review of localStorage partial failures and replay restoration in the public project source.
attribution: Any findings are Kiro suggestions; implementation and independent reproduction, if performed, are by Codex and must be recorded separately.
limitations: A CLI invocation is not by itself a successful model review. Read the exit status and response.
No contest submission or broad model-quality claim is established.
Raw identity output, email values, credentials, and absolute home paths are excluded.
One CLI invocation may involve multiple internal model and tool turns; exact credit consumption was not measured.
model: CLI default; no model identifier was printed in the retained response

assessment.kiro_finding_1: Accepted overwritten-warning behavior; rejected blanket loss of both prior saves. Codex adapted the notice to actual backup status.
assessment.kiro_finding_2: Rejected: only a future/unreachable aliasing scenario in the current immutable implementation.
assessment.kiro_finding_3: Accepted missing startup storage warning; Codex separated parse errors from storage-read errors.
assessment.additional_codex_finding: Original backup was removed before the replacement current-state save. Codex reproduced and fixed ordering; not attributed to Kiro.
